overview_description.description: Upsolve helps low-income Americans get a fresh start after sudden financial shocks by automating bankruptcy. It provides a free online tool that asks users questions and generates a Chapter 7 bankruptcy forms, after that, the company's lawyers will review the forms.Jonathan Petts and Rohan Pavuluri founded Upsolve in June 2016, with its headquarters in New York City.

legal_proceedings.description: Upsolve lost its First Amendment lawsuit against New York Attorney General Letitia James challenging state rules on unauthorized practice of law, after Judge Lewis A. Kaplan dismissed the case in the Southern District of New York.

legal_proceedings.description: The Second Circuit ruled against Upsolve, vacating a Manhattan district court decision that shielded the nonprofit’s debt-collection guidance under the First Amendment, and held New York’s non-lawyer practice rules are content-neutral and reviewed under intermediate scrutiny.
